# Vendored front-end libraries

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| marked.min.js | https://github.com/markedjs/marked | 12.0.2 | MIT |
| purify.min.js | https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify | 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 |

They are served from `/static/vendor/` so the strict CSP (`script-src 'self'`) keeps working without a CDN.
